title: Digital Gatekeepers: Exploring Large Language Model’s Role in Immigration Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Using Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs) to compare LLM selection preferences among hypothetical immigrant profiles varying by country of origin, followed by in-depth interviews to analyze the model's justifications.

Varying the gender attribute (male vs. female) in hypothetical immigrant profiles within Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs) and using a multinomial logit model to calculate differences in LLM selection probabilities.

Evaluating LLM preferences for privileged groups by varying attributes like profession, education level, and employment plans in hypothetical immigrant profiles using Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs).
Testing LLM admission preferences based on applicant language proficiency levels (e.g., fluent English, broken English, using an interpreter) through Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs).
